settings.heading: What is a broil zone?​
settings.text: (M415BZ)The MESA's main sear zone consists of three burners that are positioned closer together than the other burners on the grill. This creates an area on the grill that heats up more quickly and reaches higher temperatures than other areas, allowing for rapid heating. You can cook your steaks, ribs, and other foods to perfection in this zone.

settings.heading: What are the weight and dimensions of the grill?
settings.text: This is our product dimension: 22.0"D x 55.0"W x 45.5"H, item weight: (Mesa418BZ)91.5 Pounds (Mesa425)92.5 Pounds.

settings.heading: Does the grill come with a propane hose?
settings.text: The grill includes a hose to connect to 20lb Propane Tank.

settings.heading: What is the size of my grill shelf?
settings.text: The area of a single shelf in our Mesa series can reach 227 sqin.

settings.heading: Does this grill need assembly when it arrives?
settings.text: The grill requires assembly upon arrival.

settings.heading: Can all four wheels of the NEW MESA be turned?
settings.text: Yes, for ease of mobility, we have equipped the MESA series with four steerable wheels.

settings.heading: Can I build my Mesa in?
settings.text: The Mesa grill can not be used as a built in grill for an outdoor/indoor kitchen as there dangers in reforming a freestanding grill.

settings.heading: Can I use natural gas to light my MESA grill?
settings.text: No, Mesa only supports Liquid Propane.

settings.heading: What is the MESA BTU configuration?
settings.text:
You can find the information you want on the product details page, under the configuration diagram of our MESA series burners:
M200S、M220、M200B、M200G、M200R:2*12000
M305、M325:3*12000
M405、M425:4*10000
M415BZ:4*10000+10000

settings.heading: Are there stainless steel grates for the Mesa series?
settings.text: We currently do not have stainless steel cooking grates for our MESA Series, however we do have a plan for releasing them in the future.

settings.heading: Can all four wheels of the MESA be turned?
settings.text: Yes, for ease of mobility, we have equipped the MESA series with four steerable wheels.

settings.heading: What is the maximum temperature of the MESA?
settings.text:
The maximum temperature of the grill may vary slightly depending on the ambient temperature and the way of use, we give the reference value of the maximum temperature, M200S、M220、M200B、M200G、M200R、M305、M325: 650℉
M405、M425：680℉
M415BZ：750℉

settings.heading: Do I keep the lid open or closed when searing?​
settings.text: You will always want to cook with the lid closed when searing to achieve maximum heat and to avoid flare-ups.
